in_hebrew.name: Ryun
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Brave, little king
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ryun הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Ryun is a name of Old English origin, derived from the words 'rye' meaning 'king' and 'un' meaning 'little' or 'one'. It is a name of great courage and nobility, evoking images of a brave and valiant ruler. The name is often associated with the Celtic god Rui, a god of the sun and strength.
